mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the cost of capital and increase equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC for the FEDFUNDS signal over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.5%, it signals economic weakness that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings face headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is above 5.5%, or the Rank IC for the UNRATE signal over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages signals robust consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained economic regime (INDPRO below 100), industrial output decline signals potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100, or the Rank IC for the INDPRO signal over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly change in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeds 200,000 jobs, it signals strong labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 200, or the Rank IC for the PAYEMS signal over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A lower level of real GDP (GDPC1) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as weaker economic activity reduces corporate earnings prospects.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 is below its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC for the GDPC1 signal over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5% and the unemployment rate falls below 5.0%, it indicates an overheating economy with aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5 and UNRATE < 5.0, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals a supply shock that disrupts corporate operations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC for the INDPRO signal over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
